screens.name: Approach — opening

screens.name: Question composer — myself

screens.name: Question composer — named person and reader variant

screens.name: Named-person editor

screens.name: Adaptive question — card 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows all four answer routes across sizes, and supplied feedback evidence reports stable positions, single advancement and heading focus.

screens.name: Adaptive question — card 2
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show the second question, progress and four options with consistent transition structure and reported single-activation feedback.

screens.name: Adaptive question — final card
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 explicitly say choosing will reveal, and supplied runtime evidence reports exactly one final request under repeated activation.
findings: Retain the explicit reveal instruction and verify equally clear wording for variable adaptive question counts.

screens.name: Answer acknowledgement — intermediate selection
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows a checked gold selection and next-question status at both sizes, with reported 180ms acknowledgement, stable layout and corrected accessible name.
findings: Validate whether novices perceive the brief acknowledgement before advancement, especially when reduced motion removes its dwell time.

screens.name: Answer acknowledgement — final selection
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the final checked answer and Revealing status, with supplied tests covering duplicate activation, cancellation and immediate reduced-motion advancement.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty input
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a labeled empty textarea, disabled Continue explanation and Back to choices, with retained browser keyboard-height evidence.
findings: Separate progress and Back to choices more clearly in the enlarged header to reduce competition with the back icon.

screens.name: Voice entry — unavailable recovery

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show the current task, expected wait, credit protection and cancellation, supported by reported timeout, cancel and motion checks.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 27–28 distinguish research from planning through status text and retain cancellation, with supplied isolated motion and timeout evidence.

screens.name: Prediction — error

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached sheets and supplied runtime narrative; no independent browser execution or artifact inspection was performed.

A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.

Corresponding normal, enlarged, reader and transition variants are grouped where they represent the same task; materially different empty, selected, loading, error and populated states are listed separately.
No listed screen or component reaches both A≥9 and F≥9; the authorized threshold is not met.
The visible evidence does not establish a hard-gate failure: content below a screenshot boundary is not itself proof of clipping or an unreachable action, especially given the reported reflow sweep.
Static transition captures support visual consistency but cannot independently establish animation continuity, timing, focus behavior or absence of distracting shifts.
Runtime reports provide substantial browser checks, but 180ms acknowledgement comprehension and effortless novice use have not been demonstrated.

Several individual states lack pictured 200% counterparts, including populated omen, offline Circles and saved check-in outcomes; expanded share and birth-details captures do not show their complete lower content.
Long repeated, synthetic and abruptly ending fixture strings are not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of lost data.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, microphone, keyboard, haptics and hardware motion remain unverified; this deferred boundary alone does not cap provisional browser scores.
Production authentication, cloud synchronization, payments, online social delivery and OS share delivery are not established by local adapters, simulated plans or browser PNG downloads.
Actual local inference and preserved answer metadata establish neither predictive accuracy nor the validity of speculative confidence labels.
Preparing and failed export screenshots are explicitly retained older evidence, and the supplied checks span identified revisions rather than one independently reviewed current-build capture set.
topFixes: Improve enlarged task proximity: keep selected Sky questions, composer alternatives, optional-form exits and download actions closer to the content they operate on.
Make unfocused question inputs visibly editable and standardize secondary navigation, disclosure and action affordances.
Add concise labels to reasoning sections and stronger grouping between long question-answer blocks.
Complete normal and 200% evidence for birth-details lookup/recovery, expanded sharing, saved outcomes, populated omen and current export states.
Validate brief answer acknowledgement with novice users, then verify announcements, focus, keyboard editing and motion on the physical phone.
